name: Proforma Invoice Generator
title: Proforma Invoice Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Make a proforma invoice with buyer details, items, optional tax, validity date and bank details. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Send a buyer a clear advance invoice before the order is confirmed or paid.
intro: A proforma invoice tells a buyer what the final invoice will contain. It is often used to confirm an order, to ask for an advance payment, or to support an import or bank application.
It is not a tax invoice. When you deliver and the sale happens, a registered person issues a sales tax invoice. Everything is made in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to BIZEASE.
how: Add the buyer and items with quantity and rate.
Set a validity date so the price does not stay open for ever.
Put bank details and terms in the notes box.
The sheet carries a line saying it is not a tax invoice.
example: 10 units at Rs. 5,000 = Rs. 50,000. With 0% tax the proforma total is Rs. 50,000. When the goods are delivered you issue the tax invoice.
mistakes: Treating a proforma as a tax invoice.
Leaving out delivery time and payment terms.
Changing the final invoice without telling the buyer.

faq.q: Is a proforma invoice a tax invoice?
faq.a: No. It is a quote in invoice form. A registered person issues a sales tax invoice for the actual taxable supply.

faq.q: Can a buyer pay against a proforma invoice?
faq.a: Yes, many buyers pay an advance against it. Keep a receipt for the payment.
You can show tax as a line or quote exclusive of tax. This tool lets you do either.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. A proforma invoice is not a tax invoice and does not file anything with FBR. It is not legal or tax advice.
